```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
#| column: screen

library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Define cities with colors and URLs
cities <- data.frame(
  name = c("Patagonia", "Ciudad de México", "New York City", 
           "Barcelona", "Bari"),
  lat  = c(-50.9423, 19.4326, 40.7128, 41.3851, 41.1171),
  lng  = c(-73.4068, -99.1332, -74.0060, 2.1734, 16.8719),
  url  = c("notes/01/", "notes/02/", "notes/03/", "notes/04/", "notes/05/"),
  color = c("#0B3C5D", "#328CC1", "#D9B310", "#1D2731", "#B82601")
)

# Predefined paths following approximate land routes
paths <- list(
  list(  # Patagonia -> CdM
    c(-50.9423, -73.4068), c(-40,-70), c(-20,-70), c(10,-95), c(19.4326,-99.1332)
  ),
  list(  # CdM -> NYC
    c(19.4326,-99.1332), c(30,-95), c(38,-90), c(40.7128,-74.0060)
  ),
  list(  # NYC -> BCN
    c(40.7128,-74.0060), c(50,-30), c(41.3851,2.1734)
  ),
  list(  # BCN -> Bari
    c(41.3851,2.1734), c(42,7), c(41.1171,16.8719)
  )
)

leaflet(options = leafletOptions(
  minZoom = 2,
  maxZoom = 7,
  scrollWheelZoom = FALSE,
  zoomControl = TRUE
))
```
